svg.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
svg.text: PR #0017 · v4.0.0: description permalinks are verified against GitHub, not just shaped
main has carried a contract change since #12 that no consumer can see, because
only a tag moves; this PR names it v4.0.0 so release.sh can cut it and move v4.

g.text: CHANGELOG.md
## Unreleased -- "Contract change: cut this as v4" (#12, #16)
release.sh refuses: no "## vX.Y.Z" section to publish as notes
contract references still say v3
action.yml ${ACTION_REF:-v3} (the recipe's curl URLs)
README.md uses: meawoppl/visual-pr@v3, .../sweep@v3, raw .../v3/
test_docs.py test_versioning_is_consistent asserts @v3
release.sh v4.0.0 would die on each of these checks in turn
every @v3 consumer still runs the shape-only check
agent-portal, focalplane, tracking-test-bench, ... : a phantom SHA
or a branch URL in the description is green today (#15)

svg.text: Moving v3 onto main instead would be the v1 mistake again:
passing PRs on every @v3 consumer would start failing with no tag change.

g.text: CHANGELOG.md
a fresh, empty ## Unreleased above it for the next bundle
contract references say v4, in the same PR
action.yml ${ACTION_REF:-v4}
README.md uses: meawoppl/visual-pr@v4, .../sweep@v4, raw .../v4/
test_docs.py asserts @v4 and that @v1, @v2, @v3 are gone from README
README's Versioning: v4 moves, v3 is frozen on the shape-only contract
./release.sh v4.0.0 after the merge
tags v4.0.0, moves v4, verifies the raw URLs at v4, publishes the
release with this section as notes; consumers move to @v4 by PR

svg.text: Nothing changes for @v3 consumers until their own workflow says @v4;
v3 stays exactly where it is, and never moves again.
Merging this PR moves no tag; the tag moves only when release.sh runs from a clean main. Consumer upgrades are separate PRs in their repos.
